import unittest
import catering_bill as app

class Behavior(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_quantities(self):
        self.assertEqual(app.subtotal_cents([{'unit_cents': 1800, 'quantity': 3}]), 5400)
        lines = [{'unit_cents': 125, 'quantity': 2}, {'unit_cents': 400, 'quantity': 0}, {'unit_cents': 0, 'quantity': 9}]
        self.assertEqual(app.subtotal_cents(lines), 250)
        self.assertEqual(lines, [{'unit_cents': 125, 'quantity': 2}, {'unit_cents': 400, 'quantity': 0}, {'unit_cents': 0, 'quantity': 9}])
    def test_empty_and_large(self):
        self.assertEqual(app.subtotal_cents([]), 0)
        result = app.subtotal_cents([{'unit_cents': 900000000000001, 'quantity': 9}])
        self.assertEqual(result, 8100000000000009)
        self.assertIs(type(result), int)

    def test_additional_behavior(self):
        lines = [{'unit_cents': 137, 'quantity': 3}, {'unit_cents': 829, 'quantity': 2}, {'unit_cents': 41, 'quantity': 5}]
        before = [dict(line) for line in lines]
        result = app.subtotal_cents(lines)
        self.assertEqual(result, 2274)
        self.assertIs(type(result), int)
        self.assertEqual(lines, before)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
